en: The natural society of the family expands into the universal state society, which is just as much a connection founded by nature as one entered into by free will and rests just as much on right as on morality; but in general it appears not so much as a society composed of individuals as an individual spirit of a people that is unified in itself.
zh: 家庭的自然社会扩展为普遍的国家社会；这国家社会既是由自然奠基的结合，也是由自由意志缔结的结合，同样既以权利为基础，也以道德为基础；但总的来说，它与其说出现为一个由个体组成的社会，不如说出现为一个自身统一的、个体性的民族精神。

en: The science of the state is the representation of the organization which a people has as an organic whole living in itself.
zh: 国家科学是一个民族作为自在地活着的有机整体所具有的组织的表述。

en: The state, as the universal, makes the opposition to the individuals.
It is all the more perfect the more the universal corresponds to reason and the more the individuals are one with the spirit of the whole.

The essential disposition of the citizens towards the state and its government is neither blind obedience to its commands, nor that everyone would have to give his individual consent to the institutions and measures in the state, but trust and an insightful obedience towards them.
zh: 国家作为普遍者，与个体构成对立。
它越发完善：普遍者越符合理性，个体越与整体的精神合为一体。
公民对国家及其政府的基本心态，既不是对其命令的盲目服从，也不是国家的各项设施和措施都要每个人各自给出同意，而是对它们的信任和有见识的服从。

en: The state contains various powers which constitute the moments of its organization.

The legislative, judicial and executive power in general are the abstract moments of it. - The real powers are the constituting of the whole, the judicial and police, the financial and administrative, the military and political power, in each of which those abstract moments in fact occur. - The highest active centre of them all is the government.
zh: 国家包含各种权力，它们构成其组织的诸环节。
立法、司法与行政权力一般说来是它的抽象环节。 - 实在的权力是构成整体的权力、司法权与治安权、财政权与行政权、军事权与政治权，在其中每一种权力上都实际出现那些抽象环节。 - 一切权力中最高的活动中心是政府。

en: The different estates of a state are in general concrete differences, according to which the individuals divide themselves into classes which rest chiefly on the inequality of wealth, of upbringing and formation, as well as these in part again on the inequality of birth, by which the individuals become more applicable to one kind of activity for the state than to another.
zh: 一个国家的不同等级总的说来是具体的差异，个人按照这些差异分为若干类；这些类主要建立在财富、教育与教养的不平等之上，而教育与教养的不平等又部分地建立在出身的不平等之上；由此个人对国家的某一种活动比另一种活动更加适用。

en: The constitution determines the separation and the relation of the various powers of the state to one another and the sphere of action of each one of them, above all the rights of the individuals in relation to the state and the share of participation in these powers which they are to have not merely in the election of the government but also, insofar as they are citizens as such.
zh: 宪法规定各个国家权力彼此之间的分离与关系，规定其中每一个的作用范围，尤其是规定个人相对于国家的权利，以及个人所应当具有的参与这些权力的分量；这种参与不只在选举政府时才有，而且就个人作为公民而言本来就应当有。

en: Customs, laws and the constitution make up the organized inner life of a spirit of a people.
The principle, or the manner and determination, of its essence is expressed in it.
Besides, it has an external relation and external fates.
zh: 风俗、法律和宪法构成一个民族精神有组织的内在生活。
其中表达出来的是他的本质的原则，或者其样式与规定。
此外，它还有一种外在的关系和外在的命运。

en: This so-called historical history considers the existence of a spirit of a people, the development of its principle in its constitution and laws and in its fates, in an external way according to the perception of the events and the immediate causes, as they seem to lie in contingent circumstances and individual characters.
zh: 这个所谓的历史的历史，考察一个民族精神的存在、它的原则在其宪法和法律中以及在其命运中的发展，考察的方式是外在的，依据是对事件的知觉和直接的原因——这些原因看起来处在偶然的情势和个人的性格之中。

en: The philosophical history does not only grasp the principle of a people from its institutions and fates and develop the events out of the former, but considers above all the general world spirit, how it has in an inner connection passed through the various stages of its formation through the history of the nations which appear separated and their fates.
It represents the general spirit as substance appearing in its accidents, so that these accidents, its shape or externality, are not formed in equal measure with its essence.
Its higher representation is its shaping in simple spiritual form.
zh: 哲学的历史不仅仅从一个民族的制度与命运中把握住这个民族的原则，并从这个原则推演事件，而且主要考察普遍的世界精神：它如何在一个内在联系中，通过那些显得彼此分离的民族的历史及其命运，经历了自身教养的各个阶段。
它把普遍精神表述为在诸偶性中显现的实体，以至于这些偶性——它的形态或外在性——并没有与它的本质同样地得到塑造。
它更高的表述就是它在简单的精神形式中的形态化。

en: (Not all peoples count in world history.
Each has, according to its principle, its point, its moment.
Then, as it seems, it retires from the stage for good.
Its turn comes not by chance.)
zh: （世界历史中并不是所有民族都算数。
每一个民族都按其原则有自己的着眼点、自己的环节。
于是它似乎就永远退出舞台了。
它的时序并非偶然而来。）

20.en: Third Section Spirit in Its Pure Presentation
20.zh: 第三节 精神在纯粹表现中的样子

en: Art presents the spirit in individuality and at the same time purified from contingent determinate being and its changes and from external conditions, and presents it objectively for intuition and representation.
The beautiful in and for itself is the object of art, not the imitation of nature, which is itself only a temporal and unfree imitation of the idea.
Aesthetics considers the more proximate forms of this beautiful presentation.
zh: 艺术把精神表现为个体性，并且同时表现为从偶然的定在及其变化中、从外在的条件中净化出来的；而且是客观地表现为直观和表象。
自在自为的美是艺术的对象，而不是对自然的摹仿；自然本身不过是对观念的一种仅仅时间性的、不自由的摹仿。
美学考察这种美的表现的较切近的形式。

en: (Art depends on what substantive consciousness the spirit is.
We study the Greek works and are therefore not Greeks.
It is not the representation that does this, but the inner productive life — that we ourselves are that.
The phantasy of a people is not a superstition of something but the spirit itself; the so-called marvelous is a trivial piece of machinery; Klopstock's blunder with his angels and northern gods.
The living mythology of a people therefore constitutes the ground and content of its art.)
zh: （艺术取决于精神是哪种实体性的意识。
我们研究希腊人的作品，所以并不是希腊人。
起作用的不是表象，而是内在的生产性生命，——就是我们自己就是这个东西。
民族的想象并不是对某种东西的迷信，而是精神自身；所谓的神奇不过是一套无聊的机械装置；克洛普施克搞出他的天使、北欧诸神，是一桩错事。
因此，一个民族的活的神话构成其艺术的根本与内容。）

en: Two main forms or styles of art are to be distinguished, the ancient and the modern.
The character of the first is plastic, objective; that of the other is romantic, subjective.
The ancient presents individuality at the same time as a universal, essential character, without on that account passing over into abstraction and allegory, but remaining a living totality.
In its objective clarity and composure it effaces the contingent and the arbitrary of the subjective.
zh: 艺术须区分两种主要形式或风格，即古代的和现代的。
前者的性格是塑造性的、客观的，后者的是浪漫的、主观的。
古代艺术把个体性同时表现为普遍的、本质的性格，却并不因此落入抽象和寓言，而仍然是有生命的总体性。
在客观的清晰与持守中，它抹去了主观方面偶然与任意的成分。

en: The arts differ according to their kinds by the element in which they present the beautiful and by which the object and spirit of this presentation are more closely determined.
For outer intuition painting gives a coloured shaping on a surface, sculpture a colourless shaping in three-dimensional form.
For inner intuition music presents in tones devoid of representation, poetry through language.
zh: 各种艺术按门类相区分，靠的是它们在其中表现美的那种要素，通过这一要素，这一表现的对象与精神也得到更切近的规定。
就外在的直观而言，绘画给出平面上的有彩色的造型，雕塑给出以立体形式出现的无彩色的造型。
就内在的直观而言，音乐以无表象的音调来表现，诗歌则通过语言来表现。

en: (The art of rhetoric, architecture, garden art etc. are not purely beautiful arts, because yet another purpose underlies them than the presentation of the beautiful.)
zh: （修辞艺术、建筑艺术、园林艺术等等不是纯粹的美艺，因为它们底下还另有一个不同于表现美的目的。）

en: The main kinds of poetry are the epic, the lyric and the dramatic.
The first presents an object as an external event, the second a single feeling or the subjective movement going on in the mind, the third the proper action as the effect of the will.
zh: 诗歌的主要门类是史诗的、抒情的和戏剧的。
第一种把一个对象表现为一件外在的事件，第二种表现为一种个别的感受或在心中进行的主观的活动，第三种把真正的行动表现为意志的效果。

en: Religion gives the presentation of absolute spirit not merely for intuition and representation, but also for thought and cognition.
Its principal determination is to raise the individual up to the thought of God, to bring forth its unity with him, and to make it certain of the same.
zh: 宗教给出的绝对精神的呈现，不单单是为了直观和表象，也是为了思想和认识。
它的主要规定是：把个体提高到上帝的思想，使它与上帝的统一显现出来，并使它对这一点确信不疑。

en: (Religion is truth, as it is for all men.
The essence of true religion is love.
It is essentially disposition, as cognition of the truth of the human will.
Religious love is not merely natural attachment or merely moral benevolence, not an indeterminate universal dull sensation, but [it] proves itself in the particular with absolute self-sacrifice.
"Love one another as I have loved you." 4) — Religious love is infinite power over everything finite of spirit, over what is bad, evil, crime, and even positive laws and so forth.
Christ let his disciples pluck ears of grain on the Sabbath and healed a sick hand.
Divine love forgives sin; it makes what has happened into something that has not happened for spirit.
Much is forgiven to Mary Magdalene, because she has loved much.

Love itself is beyond the considerations of morality: Mary anoints Christ instead of giving it to the poor, and Christ approves of this. — The substantial relation of man to God is the forgiveness of sins.
The ground of love is the consciousness of God and of his essence as love, and love is therefore at the same time the highest humility.

I am not to be for myself the objectivity in love, but God; yet in his knowing I am to forget myself. — The forgiveness of sin is not something temporal, no consequence of external punishment, but something eternal, inner, in spirit and mind.

The annihilation of its nullity is the loftiness of love. — The substantial relation of man to God seems in its truth to be a beyond, but the love of God to man and of man to God sublates the separation of the this-side from what is represented as a beyond, and is the eternal life.
zh: （宗教就是真理，是它对于一切人所是的真理。
真实宗教的本质是爱。
它本质上是心态，即对人的意志之真理的认识。
宗教之爱不只是自然的依恋，也不只是道德的善意，不是一种不确定的、笼统而愚钝的感受，而是［它］在个别场合以绝对的牺牲来证明自己。
“你们要彼此相爱，像我爱你们一样。”4)——宗教之爱是凌驾于精神的一切有限者之上、凌驾于坏的、恶的、罪行的乃至实定法等等之上的无限力量。
基督让他的门徒在安息日掐取谷穗，并治好了一只病手。
神圣的爱赦免罪，使发生过的事在精神那里成为未曾发生的事。
抹大拉的马利亚被赦免了很多，因为她的爱很多。
爱本身就超出道德的顾虑：抹大拉的马利亚给基督傅油，而没有把它给穷人，基督也认可这一点。——人同上帝的实体性关系就是罪的赦免。
爱的根据是对上帝及其本质（就是爱）的意识，因此爱同时也是最高的谦卑。
我在爱中不应当是我自己的客体，而应当是上帝；但在他的认识中我应当忘掉我自己。——罪的赦免不是时间性的东西，不是外在惩罚的后果，而是在精神与心中永恒的、内在的东西。
摧毁其虚无性就是爱的崇高。——人同上帝的实体性关系在其真理中似乎是一个彼岸，但上帝对人的爱与人对上帝的爱扬弃了此岸同被表象为彼岸者的分离，并且就是永生。

en: This identity is intuited in Christ.
As son of man he is son of God.
For the God-man there is no beyond.
He counts not as this individual but as the universal, as true man.
The external side of his history must be distinguished from the religious side.
He has passed through actuality, abasement, ignominy, and died.
His pain was the depth of the unity of the divine and human nature in life and suffering.
The blessed gods of the heathen were represented as being in a beyond; through Christ common actuality, this abasement which is not contemptible, is itself hallowed.
His resurrection and ascension exist only for faith: Stephen saw him in vision at the right hand of God.
The eternal life of God is this, the return into self.
To raise doubts from circumstances, from particulars as to whether this is an external actuality is trivial, sordid.
Faith is not at all concerned with the sensuous happening, but with what happens eternally.
History of God.
zh: 这一同一性在基督身上得到直观。
作为人子，他是上帝之子。
对神人来说没有彼岸。
他算作的不是这一个个体，而是普遍者、作为真实的人。
他生平的外在方面必须与宗教的方面区分开来。
他经历了现实性、卑贱、辱骂而死了。
他的痛苦是神人二性在生活与受苦中的统一的深度。
异教徒那些至福的众神被表象为处在某个彼岸之中；通过基督，共同的现实性、这种并不值得鄙视的卑贱，本身也得到圣化。
他的复活与升天只是就信仰而言：司提反在所见中看见他位于上帝的右边。
上帝的永恒生命就是这个，即向自身的回归。
从境况、从个别细节出发去怀疑这是否是一种外在的现实性，是无聊的、卑劣的。
信仰根本不取决于感性所发生的事，而取决于那永恒发生的事。
上帝的历史。

en: The reconciliation of God with man, as having occurred in and for itself, not as a chance, as an arbitrariness of God, is known in the Church.
Knowing this is the holy Spirit of the congregation. — The kingdom of God is first the invisible Church, which comprehends all zones and various religions; then the outward Church. —
zh: 上帝与人的和解作为自在自为而发生、而不是作为偶然、不是作为上帝的任意，是在教会里被知道的。
知道这一点，就是教会的圣灵。——上帝之国首先是那不可见的教会，它囊括一切地带和各种宗教；然后是外在的教会。——

en: — In the Catholic Church the congregation is divided within itself into priests and laity.
Those are the authorized representatives and exercise power.
The reconciliation with God is in part made outwardly; in general a less spiritual actuality of religion prevails among the Catholics. — Among the Protestants the priests are only teachers.
All are equal in the congregation before God as the present Spirit of the congregation.
The works as such are powerless.
What matters is faith, is the disposition.
Evil is known as something null in and for itself.
This pain must penetrate the human being.
He must freely seize the grace of God — to unite it with himself despite the evil — if he gives the evil up and withdraws from it.
Only in the mind does there come about a real community with God.
In it the sensuous form of the sacraments is transfigured as well.)
zh: ——在天主教会中，会众在自身内部分为神职人员和平信徒。
那些人是受托者，行使着强力。
与上帝的和解有一部分是在外在的方式下做成的；总的说来，在天主教徒那里统治着一种较不精神的宗教现实性。——在新教徒那里，神职人员只是教师。
所有人在会众中、在作为会众当下之精神的上帝面前都是平等的。
行为本身是无力的。
要紧的是信仰，是心态。
恶被知为自在自为的虚无。
这种痛苦必须贯穿人。
他必须自由地抓住上帝的恩典——尽管有恶，只要他放弃恶、从恶中退回来——把它与自己结合起来。
只有在心中才与上帝有真正的共同性。
在其中，圣礼的感性形式也得到升华。）

en: Science is the comprehending cognition of the absolute spirit.
Insofar as he is taken up in conceptual form, all alienness is sublated in knowing, and this has attained perfect equality with itself.
It is the concept that has itself for its content and comprehends itself.
zh: 科学是以概念把握绝对精神的认识。
在他被把握为概念形式时，一切异己存在在知识中都被扬弃了，而知识由此获得了与自身的完全同一。
这个概念以自身为内容，并以概念把握自身。

42.en: 2. Doctrine of consciousness for the middle class5)
42.zh: 2. 面向中产阶级的意识学说5)

45.en: On the kinds of consciousness, knowing and cognition
45.zh: 论意识、知识与认识的种类

en: The simple sensuous consciousness is the immediate certainty of an external object.
Such an object has first the determination to be a This, a Now according to time, a Here according to space.
(This Now vanishes and at the same time remains; as this Here comprehends many Heres within itself in a simple manner; or both are as the universal, which at the same time has differences on it.)
zh: 单纯的感性意识是对一个外在对象的直接确定性。
这样的对象首先具有这样一个规定：是一个这一个，就时间而言是这一现在，就空间而言是这一此地。
（这一现在消失了，同时又是持存的；正如这一此地以单纯的方式把许多此地包含在自身之内；或者说，两者作为一般者，同时自身上带有差别。）

en: Perception has an object which is indeed external, sensuous, but mediated — a mixture of sensuous or feeling-determinations and determinations of understanding.
The sensuous or feeling-determinations are the determinations of colour, tone, smell, taste and touch.

The determinations of understanding are individuality and the diversity of properties, which are universal and are at the same time comprehended in the individuality, which thereby constitutes a thing.
zh: 知觉有一个虽然是外在的、感性的、却是经过中介的对象——感性的或感觉的各项规定与知性的规定的混合。
感性的或感觉的各项规定就是颜色、声音、气味、味道和触摸的规定。
知性的规定是个别性和属性的相异，这些属性是普遍的，同时又包含在个别性之中，由此构成了一个物。

en: Considering more closely the relation of these determinations to one another, the properties are, each free in itself, undisturbed by the other, particular matters, and the thing is the universal compass that contains them, but at the same time, as simple individuality, it is the negative of the free indifference of these matters; they are thus not free matters but sublated ones, not being-for-themselves but only moments; their being-for-itself is the individuality that belongs to the thing alone.
zh: 更仔细地看这些规定彼此间的关系，那么这些属性每一个都自在地自由着，不受别的、特殊的物质干扰，而这个物是包含它们的那个一般范围；但它同时又作为单纯的个别性，是这些物质自由地彼此无差别的否定者；因此它们不是自由的物质，而是被扬弃了的、不是自为存在的、仅仅作为环节的东西；它们的自为存在就是那个只属于物的个别性。

53.en: Doctrine of consciousness[s] and of the soul

en: I. Spirit according to the various kinds of its object; II. according to the various kinds of its activity.
zh: I. 精神按其对象的不同种类；II. 按其活动的不同种类。

en: I. On the kinds of consciousness.
zh: I. 论意识的种类。

en: II.
On the kinds of the inner activity of spirit.
zh: II.
论精神的内在活动的种类。

en: Consciousness is in general knowledge of an object; since it is essentially the relation to such an object, it is different according to the different objects it has.
zh: 意识一般就是关于一个对象的知识；由于它本质上是对这样一个对象的关系，所以它按所具有的不同对象而不同。

en: Conversely, since the object — as the name object also expresses — is essentially determined through its relation to consciousness, it becomes different with the further development of consciousness.
zh: 反过来，由于对象——名称「对象」本身也表达了这一点——在本质上是由它与意识的关系规定的，所以它随意识自身的进一步形成而变得不同。

en: A. Consciousness of abstract objects.
zh: A. 关于抽象对象的意识。

en: B. Consciousness of the world of finite spirit.
zh: B. 关于有限精神世界的意识。

en: C. Consciousness of absolute spirit.
zh: C. 关于绝对精神的意识。

65.en: [Third Attempt] Doctrine of Spirit as an Introduction to Philosophy
65.zh: [第三种尝试] 作为哲学导论的精神学说

en: An introduction to philosophy has above all to consider the various qualities and activities of spirit through which it passes in order to arrive at science.
Since these spiritual qualities and activities stand in a necessary connection, this self-cognition likewise [makes] a science of them.
zh: 一部哲学导论主要应当考察精神为达到科学所经历的那些不同的性质与活动。
由于这些精神的性质与活动处于一种必然的联系之中，这种自我认识同样也就[构成]一门科学。

en: The doctrine of spirit considers spirit according to the various kinds of its consciousness and according to the various kinds of its activity.
The former consideration can be called the doctrine of consciousness, the latter the doctrine of the soul.
zh: 精神学说按其意识的不同种类和活动的不同种类来考察精神。
前一种考察可以称作意识学说，后一种称作灵魂学说。

en: Consciousness is in general knowledge of an object, be it an external or an internal one, regardless of whether it presents itself to consciousness without the activity of spirit or whether it has been produced by it.
Spirit is considered according to its activities insofar as the determinations of its consciousness are attributed to itself.
zh: 意识一般就是关于一个对象的知识，不管它是外在的还是内在的，也不管它是不经精神的参与而自行呈现给意识，还是由精神产生出来的。
精神是就其活动来考察的，就其意识的各种规定被归于精神自己而言。

en: [In the margin:] one knows something but does not think about it; thus one possesses it but does not have it in consciousness, not as an object.6)
zh: [页边：]人知道某物，却不去想它；这样人就占有了它，却没有在意识中、没有作为对象而具有它。6)

73.en: First Part. The Doctrine of Consciousness
73.zh: 第一部分 意识学说

en: Since consciousness essentially consists in the relation to an object, it is different according to the different objects it has.
zh: 由于意识在本质上在于与一个对象的关系，所以它按所具有的不同对象而不同。

en: At the same time, however, the object is essentially determined through the relation of consciousness to it, and it becomes different with the further development of consciousness.
zh: 但同时，对象本质上是由意识与它的关系所规定的，并且随着意识的进一步发展而变得不同。

en: Consciousness divides into three principal stages: α) the consciousness of abstract or incomplete objects, β) the consciousness of the world of finite spirit, γ) the consciousness of absolute spirit.
zh: 意识分为三个主要阶段：α) 对抽象的或不完整的对象的意识，β) 对有限精神世界的意识，γ) 对绝对精神的意识。

80.zh: A. 对抽象对象的意识7)

en: a) Sense-consciousness
zh: a) 感性意识

en: The simple sense-consciousness is the immediate certainty of an external object.

The expression for the immediacy of such an object is that it is the This; Now according to time; Here according to space, each entirely distinguished from all the others and not determined by means of another.
But both the Now and the Here disappear and show themselves as something other, and what remains is only the universal, which contains in itself the relation to what is other and the mediation.
zh: 简单的感性意识是对一个外在对象的直接确定性。
这样一个对象的直接性的表达是：它是这个；按时间说是这时；按空间说是这里，每一个都完全与所有其他者相区别，并且不是通过另一个者而得到规定的。
但这时和这里都消失，并显示为另一个东西；而留下来的只有普遍者，它本身包含着对另一个者的关系以及中介。

en: α) [The] sensuous is, abstractly, only this poor determination; [the] sensuous [is] the most abstract; it does not know [this].
This is; this simple immediacy.
Time and space, forms, universal sensuous abstractions.
Now it is day; also not day; the negative.
The Now remains as the universal, which mediates that not-day is not-night, simply as before; neither this nor that and both this and that is.
Here is a table; here is not a table; here also is not a table. - The universal.
Even this I [is] only the universal - I, they say just as well: I.
Or if I hold fast to the Now and the Here - the Now has been; is not; the Now remains. - flowing - another Here infinitely divisible; is not; right or left.
Point, thing of thought.
zh: α) [感性]在抽象的意义上只是这个贫乏的规定；[感性]是最抽象的；它不知道这一点。
这个是；这种简单的直接性。
时间与空间是形式，普遍的感性抽象物。
这时是白天；也不是白天；否定的东西。
这时作为普遍者留下来，中介着：不是白天并不是不是黑夜，正如先前一样地单纯；既不是这个也不是那个，而既是这个又是那个。
这里是一张桌子；这里不是一张桌子；这里也不是一张桌子。——普遍者。
连这个我[也]只是普遍的我——我，他们也同样说：我。
或者，如果我抓住这时和这里不放——这时曾经是；现在不是；这时依然留下。——流动的——另一个这里可以无限分割；现在不是；在右边或左边。
点，思想之物。

en: b) Perception
zh: b) 知觉

en: Perception does indeed have the sensuous, but at the same time it has the universal as its object within it, a mixture of sensuous determinations and determinations of understanding.
zh: 知觉诚然以感性之物为对象，但其中同时以普遍者为对象，是感性规定与知性规定的混合。

en: The sensuous properties are immediately in feeling, but at the same time determined through their relation to others, and mediated.

The most universal determinations of understanding are the individuality of the thing, in which the properties are contained, and the universality of those same properties, according to which they go beyond the single thing and are independent of one another.8)
zh: 感性属性直接地在感受之中，但同时又通过与其他者的关系而得到规定，并且是被中介的。
最普遍的知性规定是事物的个别性，属性就含在其中；以及这些属性的普遍性，按照这种普遍性，它们越出单个事物而彼此独立。8)

en: Thereby the following contradiction is posited: the properties, insofar as they are free in and for themselves from the individuality of the thing and undisturbed by one another, are particular, independent materials, and the thing is only the universal compass that comprehends them.

In the individuality of the thing, to which they belong inseparably, their independence and their indifferent existence are on the contrary negated, and only the thing [is] that which exists in and for itself.
zh: 由此就设定出如下矛盾：属性在自在地脱离物的个别性、又彼此不受干扰时，就是特殊的、独立的物质，而物不过是那个包含它们的普遍范围。
反过来，在物的个别性中——属性不可分离地属于它——它们的独立性和它们彼此无差别的存在被否定了，只有物[才是]那个自为存在者。

en: Mat[ter], the simple determination (quantity), the indivisible point, is both sweet and white, hard, odorous.
zh: 物[质]，单纯的规定（量），不可分的点，既是甜的，也是白的、硬的、有气味的。

en: c) The understanding
zh: c) 知性

en: Since these two determinations are equally essential in the same object and at the same time opposed to one another, neither of them is the true one, but they sublate one another.
zh: 由于这两项规定在同一对象中同样本质、同时又彼此对立，所以没有一项是真正的那一个，而是它们彼此扬弃。

en: They therefore now have the determination [to be] only as sublated ones.
Thus they make up the object of the understanding, to which they count as appearances and which considers the inner of things.
zh: 因此它们如今有了这样的规定：只有作为被扬弃者[而存在]。
这样它们就构成了知性的对象，它们作为现象归属于这个对象，而这个对象考察物的内在。

en: The inner of things is what in them is on the one hand free from appearance, but on the other hand is related to it through its concept.
It is therefore α) the simple force, which β) passes into determinate being; the expression of the force.
zh: 物的内在就是它们身上那个一方面脱离现象、另一方面又通过自身的概念与现象相关的东西。
因此它就是 α) 单纯的力，它 β) 进入定在；这是力的表现。

en: In the inner, the opposition of the determinations that is present in appearance is sublated, i.e. at the same time preserved.
The force therefore has the difference in itself, but not as sensuous manifoldness, but as an inner difference; this difference is to begin with the law of the force.
zh: 在内在之中，现象中已有的各项规定的对立被扬弃了，即同时被保存下来。
所以力把差别置于自身之内，但不是作为感性的杂多，而是作为一个内在的差别；这个差别首先是力的规律。

en: The inner going into itself, not disappearing; recollection; the force of the tree; electricity, which returns into its force.
zh: 内在在自身中走，而不是消失；回忆；树的力；电，回返到它的力。

en: The law of the force is the quiet universal image of the appearance and does indeed express a necessary relation of its two differentiated sides, but it does not contain this necessity; rather, in the law the sides of it are still indifferent to one another; and in this way the difference is not yet an inner one.
zh: 力的规律是现象的安静的普遍图像，它固然表述出它的两个有差别的方面之间一种必然的关系，却并不包含这种必然性；而在规律里，它的诸方面仍然彼此平列不分高下；并且这样一来，差别还不是内在的差别。

en: The difference as a truly inner or simple one is the difference in itself; but this pure abstraction is nothing other than the difference, which is just as much no difference; the differentiating of the undifferentiated, or the not-being-differentiated of the differentiated.
zh: 差别作为真正内在的或单纯的差别，就是自在的差别；但这一纯粹的抽象无非就是那个差别，而这个差别同样不是差别；这是对无差别者的区分，或者说是差别者的无区别状态。

en: The consciousness that has as its object only such a differentiated one as is no difference has thereby left behind the previous kind of objects.

For these were something alien to it, differentiated from it; but insofar as it has as its object the differentiated, which is no differentiated, its difference falls away from the object, or it has itself as its object.
zh: 那个只把这样一位并非差别的差别者当作对象的意识，由此就离开了此前诸对象的方式。
因为这些对象曾是某种由它区分出来的异己之物；但当它把那个并非差别者的差别者当作对象时，它的差别便从对象那里消逝了，或者它以自身为对象。

en: Questions. 3 January [1809]
Is the object of sense-certainty an abstract object?
zh: 感性确定性的对象是一个抽象的对象吗？

en: In what way do the two determinacies, universality and individuality, generate themselves from what accrues to sense-consciousness?
zh: 两个规定，即普遍性与个别性，是以何种方式从在感性意识上产生出来的东西中生成的？

en: In what way is a mediation present in universality?
zh: 普遍性中何以有一种中介？

en: When I say: thing, do I thereby say what I mean?
zh: 当我说：物，这时我说出了我所指的吗？

en: α) Appearance is the mediating, through which understanding knows the inner, or through which it is joined with it.
zh: α) 现象是那起中介作用的，通过它知性认识内在，或者通过它与内在合为一体。

en: β) Expression, relation to the appearance.
zh: β) 表现，对现象的关系。

en: γ) The inner contains the differences of appearance in a simple way, as a simple law which remains the same under the most diverse circumstances — the inner, the quiet image of the outer.
zh: γ) 内在以一种单纯的方式包含着现象的各项差别，作为一条在最为不同的境况下仍保持同一的单纯规律——那个内在，外在的安静的图像。

en: δ) Understanding has therein the distinguishing of the undifferentiated and the being-undifferentiated of the differentiated for its object.
zh: δ) 知性在其中以对无差别者的区分、以及差别者的无区别状态为它的对象。

en: a) an indifferent distinguishing, b) inner difference; difference in itself, absolute difference, c) is no difference, or the difference of the undifferentiated.
zh: a) 无差别的区分，b) 内在的差别；在其自在的差别，绝对的差别，c) 不是差别，或者是对无差别者的差别。

en: Questions 13 January [1809]
In what twofold manner is the property present in the thing?
zh: 属性是以何种两重的方式存在于物之中的？

en: As what kind of syllogism can understanding be presented?
zh: 知性可以被呈现为哪一种推论？

en: a) Recognition of self-consciousness
zh: a) 自我意识的承认

en: Self-consciousness is at first sensuous and concrete and an object to itself and to another self-consciousness as such a sensuous and concrete object.
zh: 自我意识首先是感性的、具体的，并且作为这样一个感性的、具体的对象而对自身、对另一个自我意识。

en: Self-consciousness has a determinate being inasmuch as it is recognized by another self-consciousness.

But insofar as it is immersed in the concrete stuff, it is not recognized as self-consciousness, for its essence is, in its differentiated determinate being, not to be differentiated from itself or to be a free I as object.
zh: 自我意识有一个定在，就在于它被另一个自我意识所承认。
但由于它沉陷在具体的物质之中，它就不被承认为自我意识，因为它的本质是：在它那有区别的定在中，不从自身区别开来，或者作为对象是自由的我。

en: The recognition of self-consciousness consists in this: that each is for the other the very same as it itself [is], knows itself to be precisely this, to be for the other, and thus beholds itself in that which is different from it.
zh: 自我意识的承认在于：每一个对另一个来说就是它自己[所是的]那个东西，确切地说，它知道自己正是那个为另一个而是的存在，并因此在那个与它不同的东西中直观自身。

en: Being is the not-I, inertia, not self-determination.
zh: 存在就是非我、惰性，不是自我规定。

en: The immediate trial and recognition of the same takes place through the struggle for life and death, in which each proves itself free of sensuous determinate being and thus beholds itself in the other, not as an existing thing, thus not as something alien, but in it beholds itself.
zh: 它那直接的试炼与承认是通过生死斗争而发生的；在斗争中每一个都证明自己摆脱了感性的定在，因而在另一个身上不是把对方看作一个存在的物、因而不是看作一个异己之物，而是在其中直观到自身。

en: A barbaric relation is the first stage towards culture.
zh: 野蛮的关系是走向教养的第一阶段。

en: But this natural recognizing and being-recognized is immediately vanishing, in that the proof which they give one another of the negativity of sensuous determinate being, which is the self, is only completed through its cessation, and represents freedom from sensuous determinate being, not freedom within the same.
zh: 但这种自然的承认与被承认是直接地消失着的：因为它们彼此给予的、关于感性定在（它就是自身）的否定性的证明，只有通过它的停止才得以完成；它所表明的不是在同一个感性定在中的自由，而是摆脱感性定在的自由。

en: Recognition is the object for which the other is a self-consciousness; thus to have determinate being: in its self-consciousness each sublates its otherness within itself and in the other.
zh: 承认是这样的对象：另一个自我意识作为自我意识就是为着它而有的；也就是说：每一个在其自我意识中把它的他在既在它自身中又在它物中扬弃。

en: Each is indeed certain of itself, but not of the other; hence its own certainty of itself still has no truth; for its truth would only be that its own being-for-itself had represented itself to it as an independent object or, which is the same, that the object had represented itself to it as this pure certainty of itself; that each in itself accomplishes the pure abstraction, the being-for-itself, through its own deed and again through the deed of the other — the deed of the other and the staking of his own life.
They must substantiate their certainty of themselves in themselves and in the other.
Each is outside itself; it must sublate its being-outside-self, the other, the consciousness variously entangled, its otherness as pure negation -
zh: 每一个固然对自己有确定性，但对另一个却没有；因此它自己与自身的那种确定性还没有真理；因为它的真理只能是这样：它自己的自为存在曾向它呈现为一个独立自主的对象，或者——这是同一回事——对象曾向它呈现为它自己的这种纯粹确定性；即：每一个自在地通过自己的行动、又通过他人的行动完成纯粹抽象，即自为存在——他人的行动与押上自己的生命。
它们必须在自己自身中并在另一个那里证成自身的确定性。
每一个都在自身之外；它必须扬弃自己的在外存在，即他物，即那个多方面纠缠着的意识，即它的在作为纯粹否定时的他在 -

en: Just as before sense-consciousness it was not feeling that was in question, so here in practical consciousness it is not desire; for desire, though indeed not objectless, is with respect to its object only a negative being-for-itself, - whereas feeling is only this purely positive relation of equality, without an otherness; - desire without equality, positivity.
zh: 正如在感性意识那里所涉及的并不是感觉，在这里在实践意识那里所涉及的也不是欲望；因为欲望虽然确实不是无对象的，但就对象而言却只是否定的自为存在，——相反，感觉不过是这种纯然肯定的等同关系，不含任何他在；——欲望则没有等同，只有肯定性。

en: In that which no longer is, the substantiation of his freedom has been accomplished, but in a sensuous manner, and the certainty of himself is no longer present.
The other has the certainty of himself, but that substantiation is lacking to him.
zh: 在那个已不再存在的东西上，他自由的证成已经完成，但只是以感性的方式；而他对自身的确定性已不复存在。
另一个者拥有对自身的确定性，但那种证成对他来说是欠缺的。

en: Seeking out dangers (not fear) — the ground of courage
zh: 寻求危险（不是恐惧）——勇敢的根据

en: Therefore, since sensuous being also belongs essentially to recognizing and inequality is posited first, so that for the one self-consciousness its sensuous determinate being is the essential, but for the other the inessential, the relation of lordship and bondage arises out of that first relation of two self-consciousnesses, in which lies the beginning of a liberation of the self from its inward sensuousness.
zh: 因此，由于感性存在同时也本质地属于承认，并且首先被设定的是不等同，即对一个自我意识来说它的感性定在是本质的，而对另一个来说却是非本质的，于是主人与奴隶的关系就从两个自我意识最初的那种关系中产生了；其中包含着自我从其内在感性中解放出来的开端。

en: b) [Lordship and bondage]
zh: b) [主人与奴隶]

en: The master beholds his own being-for-itself in the slave, but not the other way round; the slave has the will of the master within him and has the object only in the thing, in which he can come to an intuition of himself.
zh: 主人在奴隶身上直观到自己的自为存在，但反过来却不然；奴隶在自己内部有主人的意志，并且只在那物上才有那个对象，在其中他能够达到对自身的直观。

en: Since the slave has an alien being-for-itself within him, he is as being-for-itself activity itself, i.e. a positing of himself by the sublation of what is objectified; but since it is an alien being-for-itself, what he brings into determinate being through his activity is partly not self-determinations or his own purposes, and partly the production of a common will.
zh: 由于奴隶内部有一个异己的自为存在，他作为自为存在就是活动本身，即通过扬弃对象化的东西而设定自身；但由于那是一个异己的自为存在，他通过自己的活动使之进入定在的，一部分并不是自我规定或他自己的目的，一部分则是一个共同意志的产生。

en: The master, the self-consciousness which has substantiated its freedom from sensuous determinate being not in itself but only in the opposition against the other, remains a particular will restricted to its sensuous purposes.
It beholds the same or itself in the other and is acknowledged by this other, but does not acknowledge; a common, but not a general, will has come about.
zh: 主人——那个自我意识，它不是在自在中、而只是在与它物的对立中证成了自己摆脱感性定在的自由——仍旧是一个特殊的、局限在自己感性目的上的意志。
它在另一个者身上直观到同一个者或它自身，并被这个另一个者所承认，但并不承认；产生出来的是一个共同的、但不是普遍的意志。

en: The slave has an alien self within him and is its external will; the master mediates himself with the things through this his external will.10) As the will that is for itself, he behaves towards these as consuming desire; the slave, by contrast, as the will that is not for itself, behaves towards them as labouring and forming.
zh: 奴隶内部有一个异己的自我，并且是他外在的意志；主人通过自己这个外在的意志与诸物相中介。10) 作为自为存在着的意志，他对待诸物是消耗性的欲望；而奴隶作为不是自为存在着的意志，则相反，对待诸物是劳动着并赋形着。

en: α) alien will, first a working-off within itself of its particularity, β) going outward, positing its form outward, forming.
zh: α) 异己的意志，首先是在内心里弃除掉他的特殊性，β) 走向外部，把自己的形式设定在外，赋形着。

en: Labour according to an alien will is α) the working-off of the particularity of that will itself, β) a working upon the things or such a negative relation of the self to them as becomes the form of the things, preserves their objectivity and gives itself just such a determinate being.
zh: 依照异己的意志的劳动是 α) 弃除那个意志自身的特殊性，β) 对诸物的一种加工，或者说是自我对诸物这样一种否定关系，它成为诸物的形式，保持诸物的对象性，并给予自己这样一种定在。

en: Order — vestigia of man (the I only as form, objectivity an element of being separated from me) — checked desire
zh: 秩序——人的遗迹（我仅仅只是形式，对象性是一个与我分开的存在的要素）——被抑制的欲望

en: c) Universal self-consciousness
zh: c) 普遍的自我意识

en: Self-consciousness (which has externalized itself, given up its particularity, and through its activity has brought forth the objective intuition of itself) still has to intuit itself as a being-in-itself essence; thus it is thinking or universal self-consciousness.
zh: 自我意识（它曾外化自身，放弃了自己的特殊性，并通过自己的活动产生出对自身的对象性直观）还须把自身看作自在存在的本质；这样它就是思维着的或普遍的自我意识。

en: Relation of a self-consciousness to a self-consciousness — recognition α) of another, free [one]; β) of the I itself —
zh: 一个自我意识与一个自我意识的关系——承认 α) 另一个自由的[自我意识]；β) 我自己——

en: α) that I intuit myself in it — the giving-up of my particularity, drives11)
zh: α) 我在它之中直观我自己——放弃我的特殊性、冲动11)

en: β) in relation to it — intuiting that it does this in relation to me, in relation to itself; that my freedom is more to it than its sensuousness — since in intuiting myself in the other, my being, my will, is at the same time an other, free [self-consciousness] for another, i.e. its own deed.
zh: β) 就与它的关系而言——直观到它就与我的关系这样做这件事；直观到我的自由对它来说比它的感性更重要——因为我在他之中直观到，我的存在、我的意志同时对另一个[自我意识]来说就是一个自由的另一[自我意识]，也就是说，是它自己的行动。

en: Struggle first: each [one] wants to take the other's sensuousness away from him — one could say, purpose, overweening, to show his strength.
zh: 先是斗争，每个[人]都想夺去对方的感性——人们可以说，是目的、是僭越、是显示他的力量。

en: What does the realization of self-consciousness mean?12)
zh: 什么叫自我意识的实现？12)

en: a) The concept of self-consciousness is the consciousness that relates itself to itself, to the pure I; it is for itself.
In this concept there is a difference of the I from itself; but it is no true distinguishing; for there is no otherness in it.
Pure self-consciousness does not at the same time have objective mode, does not have the shape of an Other; it still lacks being, or the concept is not yet realized.
zh: a) 自我意识的概念就是那个以自身即纯粹的我为对象的意识；它是为自身的。
在这个概念中有我与自身的区别；但这不是真正的区分；因为其中并没有他在。
纯粹的自我意识同时并不具有对象性的方式，并不具有另一个者的形态；它还缺少定在，或者说，这个概念还没有得到实现。

en: b) The immediate self-consciousness, on the contrary, is the sensuous one; it has needs, i.e. it relates essentially to alien things which are necessary to it and alien; it is thus dependent.
Its purpose is its sensuous being.
It is indeed an object to itself, but this is its one-sided reality.
zh: b) 相反，直接的自我意识就是感性的自我意识；它有需要，也就是说，它本质上关联着对他来说既必要又陌生的物；因此它就是依赖的。
它的目的就是它感性的定在。
它自身固然是对自身的对象，但这只是它单方面的实在性。

en: c) To the realization of self-consciousness belongs α) that an Other be an object for it; to that extent, then, it becomes consciousness; but that it not sink down from self-consciousness into consciousness or lose the concept13), but rather β) that it, insofar as it is consciousness, or insofar as it has an object, intuit therein not something alien, but that both be connected, [that] the object be a free Other and its own self, that the object unite both, be at once self and object.
zh: c) 自我意识的实现包含着，α) 有另一个者作为它的对象；就此而言它就成为意识；但是它不应从自我意识下降为意识、或失去概念13)，而是 β) 就它是意识而言，或就它有一个对象而言，它在其中所直观的不是某个陌生者，而是两者被联结起来，[即]对象是一个自由的另一者并且是它自身，对象把两者统一起来，既是自身又是对象。

en: What, more precisely, is the sensuous self-consciousness like?
zh: 感性的自我意识更具体地是怎样构成的？

en: a) It fulfils the concept of self-consciousness insofar as it relates to itself, insofar as its sensuous being is its purpose — its self-preservation, its needs; its lack, which would be its self-destruction, holds it back; it satisfies its needs.
zh: a) 它在关联于自身、它的感性的定在是它的目的即它的自我保存和它的需要这一范围内，实现了自我意识的概念；它的匮乏——它若是没有匮乏就将是它的自我毁灭——阻滞着它，它满足着自己的需要。

en: b) The mode of acting in this satisfaction α) is mediation, not the immediate [one] through other things, and it brings about its relation to itself, its lacklessness; β) this mediation αα) is the sublation of otherness, the annihilation, the vanishing of objectivity; a thing is the moment of objectivity; to sublate it; not the preservation of the thing; — desire consumes, does not regard the object, sacrifices it up. — [β]β) The result is self-preservation at the cost of otherness.
zh: b) 在这种满足中进行行动的方式 α) 是中介，而不是通过其他物的直接性，它达成它与自身的关系、它的无缺；β) 这一中介 αα) 是对他在的扬弃，是对对象性的毁灭、是对象性的消失；物是对象性的环节；扬弃这个环节，而不是对物的保存；——欲望吞噬着，不顾对象，把对象献出。——[β]β) 结果是以他在为代价的自我保存。

en: c) This acting therefore is no true realization, for there is no preservation of objectivity.

Both indeed: α) object, β) I; but insofar as the object still is, then it is only this — the negative, something that I must sublate, an alien thing; γ) insofar as the I posits itself, establishes itself — alienness within it — this happens only through the sublation of the object, and the I is not objective.
zh: c) 所以这种行动不是真正的实现，因为没有对对象性的保存。
两者固然都在：α) 对象，β) 我；但是就对象还在而言，那么它只是这个——否定的东西、某个我必须扬弃的东西、陌生的物；γ) 就我在设定自身、建立自身而言——我之中的陌生性——这只通过扬弃对象才发生，而我并不是对象性的。

en: Self-consciousness passes over from there to the intuition of itself as being-in-itself and universal, and is universal or thinking self-consciousness.
zh: 自我意识由此过渡到对自身作为自在存在者与普遍者的直观，并成为普遍的或思维着的自我意识。

en: Universal self-consciousness is recognized and recognizing insofar as it is living spirit, universality — which is at the same time individuality — has given up its particularity and knows itself only as being-in-itself, hence as the same as the other.15) Likewise, insofar as a thinking recognizes itself as that which is in itself, it knows that the essence of things is conformable to its thought as such.
zh: 普遍的自我意识既是被承认的，又是进行承认的，就在于它是活生生的精神、是同时又是个体性的普遍性——它放弃了自己的特殊性，并且只把自己看作自在的，因而看作与他人同一者。15) 同样地，就一个思维把自己认识为那个自在者而言，它知道，与它作为这样一个思维相符合的就是事物的本质。

en: Reason recognizes truth in that truth is the agreement of the concept with determinate being, but the determinations of reason are just as much its own thoughts as they are determinations of the essence of things. - In rational consideration, therefore, the previous distinction between consciousness and object falls away; in it there are contained just as much the certainty of myself as objectivity.
zh: 理性认识真理，因为真理是概念与定在的符合；而理性的规定也同样是自己的思想，正如它们是事物本质的规定一样。 - 在理性的考察中，先前意识与对象的区别因而消逝了；其中同样既有对我自己的确定性，也有对象性。

en: Reason recognizes truth in that truth is the agreement of the concept with determinate being, but the determinations of reason are just as much its own thoughts as they are determinations of the essence of things. - In rational consideration, therefore, the previous distinction between consciousness and object falls away; in it there are contained just as much the certainty of myself as objectivity.
zh: 理性认识真理，因为真理是概念与定在的符合；而理性的规定也同样是自己的思想，正如它们是事物本质的规定一样。 - 在理性的考察中，先前意识与对象的区别因而消逝了；其中同样既有对我自己的确定性，也有对象性。

en: The logical determinations are the general determinations, laws, and movements of this thinking, and are of a twofold kind, the one time insofar as they are ascribed to what exists, the other time insofar as they are ascribed to thinking as such, whereby, however, reason has the consciousness that these determinations accrue to each of these two sides.
zh: 逻辑的规定就是这一思维的一般规定、规律与运动，并且有双重的性质，一次是就它们被归给存在者而言，另一次是就它们被归给思维本身而言；但理性有这样的意识：这些规定归于这两个方面中的每一个。

en: Logic divides into the logic of the objective, of the subjective, and of the idea.
zh: 逻辑学分为客观的逻辑、主观的逻辑和观念的逻辑。

191.zh: 第一部分 客观逻辑

en: The logical determinations, insofar as they are said of what exists, have been called categories, as relations of the power of judgment, in their dialectical nature those of reason.
zh: 逻辑的规定，就其是从存在者出发被说出的而言，被称为范畴；作为判断力的诸种关系，就其辩证的本性而言，是理性的。

en: Understanding in the narrower sense is the thinking which holds fast to the fixed determination, the category.
zh: 狭义的知性是这样的思维：它固守于已固定的规定，即范畴。

en: The categories are categories of being, of essence, and of the self-standing relation.
zh: 范畴是存在、本质和独立关系的范畴。

en: a) The categories of being are quality, quantity, and infinity.
zh: a) 存在的范畴是质、量和无限性。

en: Quality is the determinacy as being-in-itself, with whose alteration that also is altered20) whose determinacy it is.
zh: 质是自在的规定性，它的变化也使那个以它为规定性的东西随之改变20)。

en: Quantity is the determinacy as external, against whose alteration that to which it belongs is indifferent, or a determinacy that is at the same time no determinacy.
zh: 量是外在的规定性，对它的变化那个它所属的东西是无所谓的；或者说，是一种同时又不是规定性的规定性。

en: Infinity is the self-determining that refers to itself, the positing of an immanent determinacy of its own, which is just as much an indifferent determinate being in the one positing.
zh: 无限性是那种以自身为对象的自我规定，是内在的、自身的规定性的设定，而这种规定性在设定者那里同样是无所谓的定在。

en: (Freedom in its determination, in limitation.)
zh: （自由在其规定中，在界限中。）

en: b) The categories of essence are matter, form, and ground.
zh: b) 本质的范畴是物质、形式和根据。

en: Matter is essence as equality with itself.
zh: 物质是本质，是与自身等同者。

en: Form is the active one, or the positing of the difference in general.
zh: 形式是能动者，或者说，是对差别的一般性设定。

en: Ground is the activity that determines itself from itself, which partly alters external determinations, in that it makes them internal, and partly translates this internal into external determinate being.
zh: 根据是那种从自身出发规定自身的活动，它一部分改变外在的规定，把它们变为内在的，一部分则把这内在的译成外在的定在。

en: Matter – stones – ground for the parts something other, exchange in the interior
zh: 物质—石头—根据 对部分 某种别的东西 内在的互换

en: Ground is α) a whole that determines the parts and has a matter as its condition, β) a force which is conditioned for its expression by a soliciting activity; γ) but it is the interior, which presents itself unconditionally in its exterior, so that the one is only the complete counterpart of the other and has no content that would not be in the other.
zh: 根据是：α) 整体，它规定各部分，并以物质为条件；β) 力，它的显现以某种召唤的活动为条件；γ) 但根据又是内在者，它无条件地呈现在它的外在者之中，以至于这一个只是另一个的完整对照物，并且没有不在另一个之中的内容。

en: c) The categories of the independent relation are substantiality, causality, and reciprocal action.
zh: c) 独立的关系的范畴是实体性、因果性和相互作用。

en: Substance is the whole of the relation, whose members set themselves up as independent, but whose essence is to be at the same time in relation to substance, that is, to be as accidents.
zh: 实体是这一关系的整体，它的各个成员把自己设定为独立的；但这些成员的本质是：同时与实体相关联，即作为偶性而存在。

en: Substance is cause insofar as it relates itself as active; what is brought forth through its activity is the effect.
zh: 实体在它作为能动者而与自身相关的地方就是原因；通过它的活动产生出来的东西就是效果。

en: In the effect there is nothing that is not in the cause, or the effect is the content of substance itself, and substance stands in reciprocal action only with itself through its activity.
zh: 效果里没有任何东西是不在原因之中的，或者，效果就是实体自身的内容，而实体通过它的活动只与自身处于相互作用之中。

en: The relations of being can be called ontological judgments, and are either identical or synthetic.
zh: 存在的诸关联可以称作本体论的判断，并且要么是同一的，要么是综合的。

en: In the identical relation, A = A, the two terms related to one another are one and the same.21) – The ontological proposition of identity is: every thing is in unity with itself, or, expressed as the proposition of contradiction: no thing can at the same time be and not be.
zh: 在同一的关联中，A = A，两个相互关联者是同一个东西。21)——同一性的本体论命题是：每一个东西都与自身处于统一之中，或者，用矛盾命题表述出来：没有任何东西能够同时既存在又不存在。

en: In the synthetic judgment, something is related to another determination than that which it immediately contains; but since this judgment is a relation, it is in part identical, but in part also not.
zh: 在综合的判断中，某物被关联到不同于它直接所包含者的另一规定上；但由于这一判断是一种关联，所以它一部分是同一的，一部分却又不是。

en: The relation to what is other is a) that of difference in general; and stated generally as a proposition: There are no two things which are perfectly equal to each other; otherwise they would be the same22); - sensuous difference, sensuous determinate being.
zh: 对他者的关系是 a) 一般意义上的相异；若一般地表述为命题：没有两个东西是完全彼此等同的；否则它们就会是同一个22)；——感性的相异，感性的定在。

en: b) The relation of opposition; in it one determination is the positive and the other the negative of that same determination; stated as an ontological proposition: Of opposed predicates the one appertains to each thing, A is either B or -B; there is no third.
zh: b) 对立的关系；在其中，一个规定是这同一个规定肯定的，另一个则是它否定的；表述为本体论命题：在相对立的谓词中，总有一个属于每个事物，A 或者说是 B，或者说是 -B；没有第三者。

en: The ground is the simple third which contains in itself the difference and the opposition of determinate being.
The principle of ground is called: Everything has a sufficient ground.
zh: 根据是单纯的三者，它在自身中包含着定在的相异与对立。
根据命题叫做：一切都有一个充分的根据。

en: makes white and black - crooked and straight; organic and inorganic - sun and light, earth; the determinate being is the externality of opposed relations, as different ones
zh: 分出白与黑——曲与直；有机与无机——太阳与光、大地；定在是相对立诸关系的外在性，作为相异者

en: Reason appears in relation to the determinations of understanding and of judgment as the dialectical movement of these.
zh: 理性在与知性的规定和判断的规定的关系中，显现为这些规定的辩证运动。

en: The dialectic of reason consists in showing forth the nature of these determinations, or rather in the nature of these determinations themselves, that in themselves they are not what they are posited to be in their determinacy, but that they pass over into their opposite.
The dialectical of reason, insofar as it is at first only the sublation of the determinacy, is therefore at first something negative.
zh: 理性的辩证法在于展示这些规定的本性，或者更确切地说，在于这些规定本身的本性：它们自在地不是它们在其规定性中被设定成的那个东西，而是过渡到它们的对立面。
理性的辩证法，就它起初只是规定的扬弃而言，因而起初是某种否定的东西。

en: The dialectical of the determinations can also be so represented, that from an ontological proposition which states a determinacy of understanding of what exists, its opposite can just as well be proved as itself.
zh: 这些规定的辩证法也可以这样表象：同一个本体论命题——它从存在者出发说出知性的一个规定——其对立面也同样可以像它本身一样得到证明。

en: Of what exists, on the one hand the one category can just as well be predicated as its opposite altogether; on the other hand, insofar as what exists is predicated through the category as something finite or conditioned, the negative dialectic has the form that what exists is at the same time represented as finite and at the same time as infinite in the ordinary sense of the word.
zh: 对存在者，一方面一个范畴同它的对立范畴总的来说同样可以被说出；另一方面，就存在者通过该范畴被说成一个有限者或有条件者而言，否定的辩证法具有这样的形式：存在者同时被表象为有限的，同时又被表象为通常意义所说的无限的。

en: Infinity
Going beyond the determinacy α) world - beginning, and bounded in space β) atoms, divisible to infinity γ) first unconditioned cause, or going forth into the infinite
zh: 无限性
超出规定 α) 世界——开端，并在空间中受界限 β) 原子，可无限分割 γ) 第一无条件的因，或向着无限者前进

en: These representations have been called antinomies of reason, - and this expression is not to be understood as if reason were incapable of recognizing the essence of what exists and thereby fell only into contradiction, but as meaning that into the determinations, as understanding holds them fast, this contradiction falls.
zh: 这些表述被称为理性的二律背反，——这一说法不应当理解为：理性无力认识存在者的本质，因而只在其中陷入矛盾；而应理解为：这个矛盾落入知性所固守的那些规定之中。

253.en: 1. Dialectic of the Categories of Being

en: A. In the qualitative α) being is the abstraction completely without content and without determinacy; it is therefore the same as the nothing, which likewise is in thinking and thus has the same being as being itself.
Being and nothing therefore do not have a truth as separate determinacies of understanding, but their truth is their passing over, the becoming.
zh: A. 在质的规定中 α) 存在是完全无内容、无规定的抽象；因此它与无是同一个，而无在思维中同样存在，因而具有与存在本身相同的存在。
所以，存在与无并不是作为彼此分开的知性的规定而有一个真理；它们的真理就是它们的过渡，即生成。

en: β) Determinate being distinguishes itself from others through its determinacy and is thereby what it is.23) But the determinacy is essentially relation to what is other, being-for-other, being unequal to itself, and sublates itself.
Through its determinacy, determinate being is therefore just as much not what it is, but becomes another, becomes changed.
zh: β) 定在通过自己的规定性而与他人相区别，并由此成为它所是的东西。23) 但规定性本质上是对他者的关系，为他者的存在，与自身不相等，并把自己扬弃。
所以，通过自己的规定性，定在同样不是它所是的东西，而是变成另一个东西，变成被改变了的东西。

en: Weathering, salt - tree, life in general, growing, development
zh: 风化、盐——树、生命一般、生长、发展

en: Being-for-itself is the One which preserves itself precisely by excluding others and by not being what the many Others are.
But this repulsion is a relation to the Many, or the Many all have only the one and same determination, to be Many; they are therefore not many, not distinct, but One.
Repulsion is therefore quite as much attraction; the excluding of the Many is continuity with them, just as these, as being-one, are excluding, repulsion.
zh: 自为存在是一，它之所以保持住自身，正是靠它排除别的，并且不是那许多他物所是的东西。
但这种排斥就是对多者的关系，或者说多者全都只有同一个规定，即去成为多者；因此它们不是多，不是有差别的，而是一。
所以排斥同样就是吸引；把多者排除在外就是与它们的连续性，正如它们作为合一，正是排除、正是排斥。

en: B. In the quantitative, the limit by which something is any determinate quantum is an indifferent limit which points immediately to its beyond.

Magnitude is therefore determined as something finite which one must go beyond; but every enlargement or diminution itself likewise brings only something finite, over against which infinity still remains, towards which the progress into the infinite only strives but which it does not reach.
zh: B. 在量的方面，使某物成为某个规定量数的那种界限，是一个无所谓的界限，它直接指向自己的彼岸。
因此大小被规定为一个有限者，必须越它而过；但每一次扩大或缩小本身同样也只带来一个有限者，与之相对的无限性仍然留在那里，进向无限者的进程只趋向于它，却达不到它。

en: Since the finite immediately points beyond itself and is posited as not being-in-itself, as something only to be sublated, its opposite, the infinite, holds absolutely.
But the progress into the infinite is only the empty repetition of the sublation of a limit, the positing of a new one and the re-sublation of the same.

The infinite itself is partly the merely empty negation of the finite; but partly it is itself finite, for it is opposed to the finite, thereby distinguished and determined against it; but a determinate is a finite.
zh: 由于有限者直接指向自身之外，并且被设定为一个自在存在并非如此的东西、一个只是应当被扬弃的东西，它的对立面即无限者就绝对地成立。
但进向无限者的过程不过是空洞地重复：扬弃一个界限，设定一个新的界限，又重新扬弃同一个界限。
无限者自身一部分只是有限者的空洞否定；但另一方面它自己又是有限的，因为它与有限者相对立，因而与它相区别、相对于它被规定；而一个被规定者就是有限者。

en: That neither the finite nor the infinite opposed to the finite has truth appears, in relation to space and time, as the antinomy of the finitude and infinity of the world in space and time, in that one has to assert just as much that the world has a beginning in time as that it has none, that the world is limited in respect of space as that it is unlimited in respect of the same.
zh: 有限者以及与有限者相对立的那个无限者都没有真理，这一点就空间和时间而言表现为世界在空间与时间中的有限性与无限性的二律背反，因为人们同样必须断言世界在时间中有一个开端，与断言它没有开端一样；同样必须断言世界就空间而言是有限的，与断言它就同一空间而言是无限制的一样。

en: I. Thesis: The world has a beginning in time.

Proof: Let it be assumed that the world has no beginning in respect of time; thus to every given point of time an eternity has elapsed, and consequently an infinite series of states of things in the world succeeding one another has flowed past.
But the infinity of a series consists in this, that it cannot be completed through successive comprehension.
Thus [is] an infinite world-series impossible, and consequently a beginning of the world in time is necessary.
zh: I. 命题：世界在时间中有一个开端。
证明：假定世界就时间而言没有开端；这样到任何一个给定的时点为止，一个永恒已经过去，因而一串相继接续的世界中事物状态的无穷序列也已经流逝。
但一个序列的无限性正在于：它不能通过逐次综合而得到完成。
所以[是]一个无穷的世界序列不可能，因而世界在时间中的开端是必然的。

en: Time has a limit; the now is the absolute limit - the beginning of the world, the proposition: now is the world, in contrast with its not-determinate-being.
It was not, i.e. one has to go beyond its determinate being to a not-determinate being, and beyond its not-determinate being into determinate being, to the beginning.
Conversely, one can only go beyond determinate being to another determinate being.
zh: 时间有一个界限；这时是绝对界限——世界的开端，这个命题：这时是这世界，与它的非定在相对立。
它曾不在，也就是说，必须越出它的定在而到非定在，并且越过它的非定在而进入定在，进入开端。
反过来，对定在只能越到另一个定在者那里去。

en: Antithesis: The world has no beginning in time and is infinite in time.
zh: 反命题：世界在时间中有一个开端，并且在时间中是无穷的。

en: 25) Proof: Let it be posited that it had a beginning, then there would be a time before the beginning in which it would not be there - empty time.

But in an empty time nothing can come to be; for therein there is no condition of determinate being; and determinate being has determinate being for its condition, or is limited by another determinate being.
Thus the world cannot have a beginning, but every determinate being presupposes another, and so on into the infinite.
zh: 25) 证明：假定它有一个开端，那么在开端之前就有一个时间，在其中它并不存在——空的时间。
但在空的时间里不可能有任何东西产生；因为其中没有定在的任何条件；而定在者以定在者为条件，或者被另一个定在者所限制。
所以世界不能有一个开端，而是每一个定在都以另一个定在在先，如此一直延伸到无限。

en: II.
Thesis: The world is limited in respect to space.
zh: II.
命题：世界就空间而言是有界限的。

en: Proof: Assume that it is unlimited; then it is an infinite given whole of simultaneously existing things, and it is an object at all.
Such a whole can only be regarded as completed through the synthesis of the parts it contains.
But this completion would require an infinite time, which would have to be assumed as elapsed, which is impossible.
Consequently an infinite aggregate of existing things cannot be regarded as a given, and hence not as a simultaneously given, whole; the world is accordingly not infinite but enclosed within limits.
zh: 证明：假定它是无界限的，那么它就是一个同时存在着的诸物的无限给定整体，并且它总归是一个对象。
这样一个整体只有通过它所包含的诸部分的综合，才能被看作已经完成的。
可是这种完成却需要一段无限的时间，而这段无限的时间必须被假定为已经流逝过，这是不可能的。
因此，一个由存在者构成的无限聚合体不能被看作一个给定的、因而也不能被看作一个同时给定的整体；世界因此不是无限的，而是被封闭在界限之内。

en: The proof is reduced back to the previous one about time, through the comprehension that occurs in time; but it can be conducted directly from space, as the previous one from time: in the previous one, namely, an elapsed time in the present instant, in the now which is (empirically) assumed; the now is this absolute time-limit, thus a limit as such (as this red is red as such).
So in space a here, the same absolute limit, thus a limit as such (without becoming transcendent).
zh: 这一证明是通过在时间中发生的把握而归结到前一个关于时间的证明上的，但它也可以像前一个关于时间的证明那样，直接从空间出发；即在前一个证明中，是当下瞬间里的一个已流逝的时间，在这被（经验地）假定的这时之中；这时就是这一绝对的时间界限，因而是界限本身（如同这红是红本身）。
同样，在空间中有一个这里，那同一个绝对界限，因而是界限本身（而不至于成为超验的）。

en: Antithesis: The world is unlimited in respect to space.
zh: 反命题：世界就空间而言是无界限的。

en: Proof: Assume that the world is limited; then it is located in an empty unlimited space.
The world would therefore have a relation to empty space.
This would be a relation to no object; but such a relation, hence the world’s relation to empty space, is nothing.
Therefore the world is infinite.
zh: 证明：假定世界是有界限的，那么它就处在一个空的、无界限的空间之中。
那么世界就有一种与空的空间的关系。
这就是与任何对象都没有的关系；而这样一种关系，因而世界与空的空间的关系，就是无。
因此世界是无限的。

en: The proofs of these antinomic propositions can be conducted directly, or they reduce themselves to the following opposition:
zh: 这些二律背反命题的证明可以直接进行，或者它们归结为如下的对立：

en: The world in space and time is 1. finite or has an absolute limit, properly the now — above in the I. Thesis the present moment in which an eternity has elapsed — and the here, instead of which in the II.
In the thesis concerning the spatial world, only this limitation, or relation to the other — namely, that it is an object — is taken into account.

These absolute limits, the now and the here, include in themselves the being of limits as such, which thus gives the world a beginning and a spatial limit for it. — Or: insofar as the absolute limit is referred to determinate being as such, determinate being has its absolute opposite in non-being; one has to go beyond determinate being to non-being, and conversely beyond non-being to determinate being; thus to set up, in respect of time, a coming-to-be or a beginning, and in respect of space, a limit.
zh: 时空中的世界是：1. 有限的，或者具有一个绝对界限，严格说就是这时——在上文第一个命题中，是那个永恒已经流逝于其中的当下环节——以及这个这里，取而代之，在第二个命题中。
在关于空间世界的命题中，只考虑到这种界限或者对他物的关系，即：它是一个对象。
这些绝对界限，即这时与这里，本身包含着「是界限本身」这一环节，因而这就给了世界一个开端和它的一个空间界限。——或者说，当绝对界限被指向定在本身时，定在者在非定在者身上有一个绝对的对立面；人是必须越过定在而到非定在，并且反过来越过非定在而到定在；因而就时间而言要设定一个产生或者一个开端，就空间而言要设定一个界限。

en: But the absolute limit, the now and the here, is only such a limit as immediately sublates itself; the limit as sublated or indifferent limit is the quantitative limit, thus progression into the infinite is posited.
Likewise with respect to determinate being, it has no absolute limit in non-being; it is also positively related to its opposite.
This opposite is therefore also a determinate being, only another one.
Thus the progression from one determinate being is only to another determinate being — into the infinite.
Thus the world in space and time is infinite.
zh: 但是绝对界限，即这时与这里，只是这样一个界限：它直接地把自己扬弃；作为被扬弃的界限或无差别的界限，界限就是量的界限，因而就是向无限的进程被设定。
同样，就与定在的关系而言，它在非定在者那里也没有一个绝对界限；它同样地对它的对立面有着肯定的关联。
所以这个对立面同样是一个定在，只不过是另一个定在。
因此，从一个定在者出发的进程只通到另一个定在者——通向无限。
因此时空中的世界是无限的。

en: Curiosity; infinite in actuality; of imagination.
Infinite self-determination, centre point, the sublation of the periphery in relation to it; circle.
zh: 好奇；无限的作用；想象力的。
无限的自我规定，中心点，外围对它而言的扬弃；圆圈。

en: Since therefore neither the finite as such nor the merely negative infinity opposed to the finite has truth, their truth is the infinite that is finite in itself or the finite that is infinite in itself; that is, the free self-determination which differentiates itself within itself, thereby posits its own limits (sides of finitude), but just as much sublates them and therein returns into itself (side of infinity).
zh: 既然有限者作为这样的有限者、仅仅否定而与有限者相对的那个无限者都没有真理，那么它们的真理就是自在地有限的无限者，或者自在地无限的有限者；也就是说，那自由的自我规定：它在自身内部区别自身，从而自己给自己设定界限（有限性的诸侧面），但同样地扬弃这些界限，并在其中返回于自身（无限性的这一侧面）。
